summary: Implemented every stub in my 29 files: VariableScreening, the discrete models and results (Logit, Probit, Poisson, NB, NB-P, GP, MNLogit), UnobservedComponents, DynamicFactor, ExponentialSmoothing (with start values, transforms and concentrated initialization), feasible GLS, origin-restricted empirical likelihood, asymmetric kernels, elliptical copula helpers, validation helpers, and the testing helpers, and restored several missing helpers (e.g. KFold.split, _intercept_idx, _maybe_convert_ynames_int). No full-suite run completed; targeted runs pass for validation (50 passed) and asymmetric kernels (30 passed) and the origin-EL numbers match the reference, while the other targeted tests are blocked by other builders' files (base/model.py has no _check_kwargs; statespace/tools.py has no prepare_exog; iolib, genmod and archimedean.py are still broken).
